title: Is an untreated human iPSC MEA recording noisier than a rat one? Split-half noise, same lab and protocol (REAL data)
status: registered before any split-half feature, change or statistic was computed for any well
origin: final-round deck review: the practical-value section gives wells needed for rat cortical chips (ToxCast) only; a judge will ask about human iPSC chips. The first design (untreated wells recorded at baseline and again at exposure) was dropped before registration: only 4 human and 6 rat such wells pass QC.

data.source: Kapucu et al. 2022 (G-Node GIN, CC-BY-4.0), spike times as deposited; data/raw/kapucu2022

primary.human: hPSC_MEA3_Pharmacology/hPSC_MEA3Baseline_DIV29: 48-well plate, 30-min untreated baseline recording, hPSC-derived cortical neurons, DIV29
primary.rat: Rat_MEA2_Pharmacology/Rat_MEA2Baseline_DIV22: 48-well plate, 30-min untreated baseline recording, rat primary cortical neurons, DIV22

replication.human: hPSC_MEA1 and hPSC_MEA2 developmental series, 12-well plates, 10-min recordings, every recording at DIV28 or later
replication.rat: Rat_MEA1 developmental series, 12-well plate, 10-min recordings, every recording at DIV21 or later
replication.treatment: NoTreatment wells only; ExcludedWell wells are not used

seen_before_registration: from the built asset (data/processed/neuromps.parquet), for the Kapucu untreated wells: record counts per plate and phase, QC flag counts, and the median firing rate and median active-electrode count per species and phase (human baseline: median 5.06 Hz, 7 active electrodes; rat baseline: median 3.09 Hz, 15 active electrodes)

for the developmental plates: file names, recording durations (600 s), number of wells with spikes (hPSC_MEA1 and hPSC_MEA2 DIV28: 6 each; Rat_MEA1 DIV21: 12), and the expLog treatment counts (hPSC_MEA1: 6 ExcludedWell, 6 NoTreatment; Rat_MEA1: 12 NoTreatment)
the report's existing numbers, including the ToxCast wells-needed table and the rat-to-human classifier transfer
no feature of any half recording, and no change between halves, for any well

method.split: each well's recording is cut at half its duration (the plate file's last spike time, as the asset uses); the second half's spike times are shifted to start at 0; both halves go through features/mea.py extract_features with default parameters and duration = half the recording
method.usable_well: not ExcludedWell in the expLog, and at least 10 active electrodes (the asset's QC threshold, active as defined by the extractor) in each half; noisy electrodes are kept, as in the asset, and their count is reported
method.change: d = log2(max(f2 / f1, 0.05)) per usable well and feature; not scored when either half is undefined or f1 <= 0; counts of unscored wells reported per feature
method.noise: SD (ddof 1) of d over usable wells, per species and feature; 1.4826 x MAD reported beside it
method.ratio: R = SD_human / SD_rat; 95% percentile interval from 2,000 bootstrap resamples of wells within each species, seed 20261028
method.replication_pooling: every usable well-recording at or after the age floor is pooled; the bootstrap resamples wells (all of a well's recordings together), seed 20261028
method.feature_scored: a feature is scored for a species comparison when at least 10 wells per species have a defined d (6 for the replication)

P1_human_firing_rate_noisier.statement: on the matched 48-well baselines, an untreated human iPSC well's firing rate moves more between the two halves of its recording than a rat well's
P1_human_firing_rate_noisier.test: pass if the 95% interval of R for mfr_hz lies above 1; fail otherwise
P1_human_firing_rate_noisier.uninterpretable: fewer than 10 usable wells in either species

P2_human_noisier_across_features.statement: the difference is not specific to firing rate
P2_human_noisier_across_features.test: pass if SD_human > SD_rat for at least 5 of the 8 features, among at least 5 scored features; fail otherwise

P3_replicates_on_developmental_plates.statement: the firing-rate result replicates on the 12-well developmental plates of the same lab
P3_replicates_on_developmental_plates.test: pass if the point estimate of R for mfr_hz on the replication pool is above 1; fail otherwise
P3_replicates_on_developmental_plates.uninterpretable: fewer than 6 usable wells in either species

reported_not_tested.wells_needed: per species, the wells per arm needed to detect a 20% and a 50% fall in firing rate against same-session controls at 5% two-sided false alarms and 80% power: n = ceil(2 (1.959964 + 0.841621)^2 SD^2 / log2(1 - fall)^2), from the primary pool's SD; stated as a LOWER BOUND, because split-half noise leaves out handling, compound addition and day-to-day variation, which the ToxCast vehicle wells include
reported_not_tested.per_feature: SD, robust SD, n wells and R with its interval for every scored feature, both pools

assumption_check.assumption: a species difference in split-half noise is not just a difference in firing rate (fewer spikes give noisier rates)
assumption_check.check: recompute R for mfr_hz on wells whose full-recording firing rate lies inside both species' 10th-90th percentile ranges (the overlap); report it with its interval and the wells kept; if it falls on the other side of 1 from the primary estimate, the report says the difference may be a firing-rate difference

reporting: all three predictions reported with their values, whatever the outcome; the comparison with the ToxCast vehicle-well numbers is qualitative only, because the noise measured differs
